correctness.rationale: Complete enumeration yields exactly 6,426 nonempty simplices. A complete acyclic matching, independently verified on all Hasse incidences, has 3,173 pairs and critical-cell vector \((1,0,0,45,32,2,0,0,0)\). Every signed integral cancellation pivot is a unit, and every entry of the resulting 80-cell Morse boundary is exactly zero; thus the homology is free of ranks 45,32,2 in degrees 3,4,5. The absence of 1- and 2-cells proves 2-connectedness and Hurewicz gives \(\pi_3\). Independent mod-two ranks are corroborating, not the integral proof.

value.rationale: The 5x5 ordinary king graph is the first square whose width lies beyond the explicit width-at-most-four homotopy classification of strong products of paths, making this exact case a natural boundary test. Three adjacent nonzero integral homology degrees, with completely torsion-free groups despite a nonpure nine-level simplicial face structure, are not deducible from the independence polynomial or existing strip results. The perfect 80-cell model and 2-connectedness provide an exact tractable benchmark for larger-width investigations, without requiring a stronger homotopy or general theorem.
